release_notes:
1. Module Manager 1-Click Update: Prominent update notification and 1-Click Update button directly inside PrestaShop Module Manager (AdminModulesManage/AdminModulesUpdates) and on the module card.
2. GA4-Compliant Item Revenue: ecommerce.value in purchase accurately calculates the item subtotal (sum of price * quantity, excluding shipping).
3. Dedicated order_totals Breakdown: Adds product_subtotal, shipping_total, tax_total, order_total, and currency from PrestaShop backend Order records.
4. Raw Unhashed user_data: Outputs plaintext customer info without SHA-256 hashing and completely omits meta_external_id.
5. Zero DOM Scraping: 100% authoritative database-driven data sourcing.
